author: Climate Town
description: I'm obsessed with an election that happened more than a quarter century ago, but I PROMISE there are lessons to be learned. The TLDR is that you should make sure you're registered to vote, and a great place to do that is Stoke The Vote DOT COM, baby! (https://protectourwinters.org/campaign/stoke-the-vote/)
title: A History Lesson About Voting
